product.title: Ce ne spune creierul
product.description: Cum a evoluat gandirea abstracta? Ce este arta? De ce radem? Ce anume ne determina identitatea sexuala? Ce este constiinta? Cum a evoluat limbajul? In ultimele doua sute de ani s‑au inregistrat progrese extraordinare in multe domenii ale stiintei. Dar in ce priveste creierul, acesta este inca o enigma. Celebrul neurolog V.S. Ramachandran, cunoscut pentru stilul extraordinar de intuitiv in care dezleaga enigme ale creierului uman si pentru conferintele sale TED, ne conduce intr-o fascinanta calatorie, pornind de la cazuri bizare – precum ale unor pacienti care se cred morti, pacienti care sufera de sindromul membrului- fantoma sau care nu ii mai pot recunoaste pe cei apropiati – si folosindu-se de acestea pentru a intelege functiile unui creier normal. Explicand, intr-un mod extrem de simplu chiar si pentru cititorul neavizat, cum este posibil ca o masa gelatinoasa de 1,3 kilograme pe care o poti tine in palme sa isi imagineze ingeri, sa contemple sensul infinitului si chiar sa isi puna intrebari cu privire la locul sau in cosmos, autorul ne arata ca, atunci cand vine vorba de modurile in care functioneaza creierul, realitatea este chiar mai spectaculoasa decat fictiunea.   V.S. Ramachandran este directorul Centrului pentru Creier si Cognitie, profesor in cadrul Departamentului de Psihologie de la Universitatea California din San Diego, profesor de biologie la Institutul Salk si membru onorific pe viata al Institutului Regal din Londra. In 2011, Time l-a inclus in lista „celor mai influenti 100 de oameni din lume“.

## Dive Into the Enigma: Exploring the Human Mind

The human brain remains one of science's greatest enigmas. How did abstract thought evolve? What truly constitutes art, identity, and consciousness? *What Does the Brain Tell Us?* takes you on a fascinating journey into the inner workings of the most complex organ in the known universe. This book tackles fundamental questionsâfrom the evolution of language to the nature of sexual identityâchallenging everything we think we know about ourselves.

Authored by an expert who makes profound science accessible, this volume reveals that when it comes to the brain's mechanics, reality is even more spectacular than fiction. It provides a comprehensive look at how our cognitive processes function, offering insights into the deepest mysteries of human existence.

## Understanding Neuroscience with V.S. Ramachandranâs Expertise

The book features insights from renowned neurologist **V.S. Ramachandran**. Known for his exceptionally intuitive approach to unraveling cerebral puzzles and delivering captivating TED talks, Dr. Ramachandran guides readers through a journey that starts with unusual cases: patients who believe they are dead, those suffering from phantom limb syndrome, or individuals struggling to recognize loved ones.

By examining these "bizarre" clinical scenarios, the book masterfully explains the functions of a normal brain. It sheds light on how we can imagine angels holding a gelatinous mass in our palms or contemplate infinite meaningâall through the workings of our incredible minds. The result is an exceptionally simple yet profound explanation of complex neuroscience, suitable even for the casual reader.

### Key Topics Covered:
*   The evolution and mechanics of abstract thought.
*   Defining art and understanding creativity.
*   Exploring the complexities of consciousness.
*   How language develops throughout history.
*   Understanding identity through neurological perspectives.

## Why This Book is a Must-Read for Science Enthusiasts

If you have ever wondered about the limits of human capability, or how such simple matter (like a gelatinous mass) can inspire infinite thought, this book delivers exhilarating answers. It doesn't just summarize scientific findings; it changes your perspective on reality itself.

Discover why understanding brain function is crucial to understanding humanity. This insightful non-fiction work by Litera will equip you with a deeper appreciation for the power and mystery of your own mind.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book too technical for a layperson?**
A: No. The author, V.S. Ramachandran, is celebrated for his ability to explain complex neurological concepts in an extremely simple manner, making it highly accessible even for readers without a scientific background.

**Q: What kind of real-world examples are used?**
A: The book draws heavily on intriguing clinical cases and patient accounts (such as those with phantom limb syndrome) to illustrate complex functions of the brain in a relatable way.
